usage_notice_text: The Harris County Elections Administrator's Office makes a diligent effort to post accurate information on this website, but assumes no liability for damages incurred directly or indirectly as a result of errors, omissions, or discrepancies. For additional information please review our Privacy Policy and our Accessibility Statement.
notes: Harris runs its own results app (harrisvotes.com Live Results iframes app.harrisvotes.com/electionresults/electionday). The app code loads appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/<electionCode>/resultsbyballot.json and, per contest, pv-<contestId>.json, rendered as a 'Precinct' voting tab, so the live site is built to show per-precinct numbers. But the files are overwritten in place: for the 2024 general (code 1124) resultsbyballot.json has dt 2024-11-15T17:30:00Z and Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:03:43 GMT; pv-7281.json (President) Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:03:22 GMT. No dated update history exists (check 1 not applicable; not Clarity). Data codes for the 2026 primary and runoff were not found (0326 and 0526 return 404) and were not guessed further. The Archives page lists only Official Cumulative and Official Canvass PDFs (e.g. 2024 general canvass file stamped 11-14-2024 03-12-57 PM); Election Reports lists reconciliation and audit forms, no election-night precinct reports. So no check could place precinct numbers on election night. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). The usage notice is the site footer on the Live Results page.
tag_rationale: All three elections are UNDETERMINED (check 1 not applicable, check 2 files overwritten after canvass, check 3 pending), so by rule the tag is UNKNOWN.
